title: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.4 improper scope validation in database tasks allowed using another workspace's…
description: JetBrains Datalore versions before 2026.4 contain a vulnerability involving improper scope validation in database tasks. This flaw allows an attacker to use another workspace's service account, potentially leading to unauthorized access. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.5.
